_doc: Per-Sanctum lifecycle tracker. v9.28 / VANTA addition to the v9.28 mission ('Apply the predicate test to the Sanctum protocol itself'). Tracks: of recent Sanctum joint resolutions, how many survived contact with the next 3 ships unmodified? If most got quietly walked back or never load-bore, the Sanctum protocol is decorative — same shape v9.28 Hydra #1 is auditing watchers for.

anti_architect_constraints.no_manual_classification: survival/walked_back/load_bore are auto-derived from CHANGELOG fix-list + Sanctum file modification times + sanctum-index entries (operator can override)
anti_architect_constraints.retroactive_classification: a Sanctum's survival is judged at next-3-ships horizon, not at ship-time; entries are back-filled as later ships ship
anti_architect_constraints.trend_over_absolute: compare survival rate across last 10 Sanctums; single-Sanctum outcome is noise

sanctums._doc: v9.28 baseline entry — measurement starts now. Pre-v9.28 Sanctums (~21 of them) are NOT retroactively classified; the AP1 risk (self-evaluation of past decisions) would compromise the data. Real classification begins at the v9.28 Sanctum forward.
sanctums.joint_resolution_summary: Ship Hydra 1-5 + Sanctum scorecard + scope-rebase pre-allocation; predicate-or-delete protocol; external-record refinement on Hydra #1
sanctums.note: v9.28 baseline entry; survival to be auto-classified at v9.31
